issues.failure_explanation: The claimed pointwise product rule for the nonlocal operator fails already at alpha=2, where (-Delta)^{alpha/2} = -Delta: the claim becomes -Delta(fg) <= 2(f(-Delta)g + g(-Delta)f), i.e. 2 grad f . grad g >= f(-Delta g) + g(-Delta f). For f = cos(2x_1), g = cos(x_1) (constant in x_2, both in H^alpha_per), the left side of the displayed inequality equals -5 at x=(pi,pi) while the right side equals -10, so the inequality is violated on a set of positive measure. The 'proof' is a single citation to a one-dimensional result; no pointwise product rule of this form holds for a nonlocal multiplier.
